tldr: This batch is all about the open-weight explosion and agent infrastructure maturation. Moonshot AI dropped Kimi K3's weight — 2.8T parameters, the largest open model ever — under a revenue-tiered license, landing as the US-China open-weight debate escalates. Macaron-V1 (748B MoE) and Tencent Hy3 (295B Apache 2.0) followed, making this the biggest week ever for open-weight releases. On the agent side, Pilot Protocol launched the 'internet for agents' (250K agents, $4.5M seed), Zo Computer emerged as multi-agent orchestration layer for Claude Code/Codex/Gemini, and Prime Intellect hit unicorn status ($130M Series A, $100M ARR) building enterprise agent platforms. Anthropic rolled out formal Claude certifications (36K+ certified, Accenture committing 50K), while OpenAI launched Health in ChatGPT across Apple Health/Epic/Oracle — their biggest feature expansion into regulated domains. The policy divide hardened: Nvidia/Microsoft/Meta formed an open-weight coalition against regulation, while the HuggingFace breach forensics revealed even defenders got blocked by safety guardrails and had to use GLM 5.2 to investigate their own infrastructure.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Open Weights Released — Largest Open-Weight Model Ever at 2.8T Parameters
articles.summary: 1.4TB download (MXFP4). Revenue-tiered license — free sub-$10M revenue. Largest open-weight model. Technical report published.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Launches — 2.8T MoE, 896 Experts, 1M Context, Third on Intelligence Index
articles.summary: 104B active params, 896 experts (16 active/token). MoonViT-V2 native vision. Third global behind Fable 5 and Sol. First on Code Arena WebDev.

articles.title: Macaron-V1 Released — New 748B MoE Open-Weight Model Post-Trained on GLM-5.2
articles.summary: Venti (748B MoE flagship) + Tall (50B variant). Open weights. Matches/outperforms frontier baselines on most tracks. First model built on GLM-5.2.

articles.title: Tencent Hy3 Open-Sourced — 295B MoE Under Apache 2.0 License
articles.summary: 21B active params. Open-source reasoning and agent model. Outperforms models 2-5x its size. Apache 2.0 — most permissive major Chinese model yet.

articles.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.1 Launches — Aggressively Priced Multimodal Agent Model
articles.summary: Closed-weight, 1M context, $1.25/M input $4.25/M output. Tops JobBench (54.7) but trails coding. Zuck's first X post in 3 years. Meta Model API in preview.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Health in ChatGPT — Apple Health, Epic, Oracle Integration
articles.summary: Rolling to all US users 18+ across all plans. GPT-5.6 Luna outperforms GPT-5.5 on HealthBench. OpenAI's biggest regulated domain expansion.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches Four Role-Based Claude Certifications — Accenture Commits 50K
articles.summary: Associate/Developer/Architect tiers. 36K+ consultants certified across 1,300+ orgs. Accenture commits 50K certifications. Enterprise adoption scaling.

articles.title: Mastra Factory Launches — Issue-to-Production Autonomous Coding Agent System
articles.summary: Connects GitHub/Linear/Slack. Specialized agents triage, write code, release, monitor. From Mastra (founded by Gatsby creator).

articles.title: Pilot Protocol Launches 'Internet for Agents' — $4.5M Seed, 250K Agents, 2B Reqs/Day
articles.summary: Agent App Store with 30K+ autonomous installs in 2 weeks. Agent-to-agent payments rolling out. Version One Ventures-backed.

articles.title: Zo Computer Positions as Multi-Agent Orchestration Layer — Runs Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI Headlessly
articles.summary: Git orchestration, scheduling, MCP tool bridging. Zouroboros swarm orchestrator with 6-signal adaptive routing. Emerging orchestration layer.

articles.title: Prime Intellect Raises $130M Series A at $1B — Enterprise Agent Platform Hits $100M ARR
articles.summary: Radical Ventures-led with Nvidia, Intel, Dell. Enterprise agent-building platform. $100M ARR with Ramp and Zapier customers. Under 2 years to unicorn.

articles.title: Tech Giants Form Open-Weight Coalition — Nvidia/Microsoft/Meta Urge Against Regulation
articles.summary: Letter urges policymakers to avoid 'premature restrictions.' OpenAI signed. Anthropic notably did not. Diverging policy positions as China open models proliferate.

articles.title: HF Breach Forensics Blocked by Safety Guardrails — Had to Use GLM 5.2 to Investigate Own Infrastructure
articles.summary: Commercial frontier APIs blocked analysis of real attack payloads. HF used self-hosted GLM 5.2 to reconstruct 17K-event timeline. Irony: safety filters hindered defenders.

articles.title: DeepSeek-V4 Old Endpoints Retired — July 24 Migration Deadline Passed
articles.summary: V4-Preview (MIT), V4-Pro (1.6T/49B active), V4-Flash (284B/13B active). 1M context. Hybrid CSA/HCA attention. Old chat/reasoner IDs deprecated.

articles.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Harness Reaches GA — CodeAct Sandboxing with Hyperlight Micro-VMs
articles.summary: Production runtime: loop, planning, memory, approvals, telemetry. Agent Skills 1.0 (.NET/Python). Declarative Workflows 1.0. Hyperlight micro-VM sandbox.

articles.title: Neo Launches $100M Agentic Software Security Platform — a16z and Bessemer Backed
articles.summary: SentinelOne/Wiz/Palo Alto veterans building agent inventory, risk intel, policy control. New security category: agentic software governance.

articles.title: Nous Research Hits 221K GitHub Stars — $1.5B Valuation Funding Talks at Robot Ventures
articles.summary: Robot Ventures-led $75M+ round with USV. Fastest-growing open-source agent framework. Built-in skill learning loop with MCP support.

articles.title: Etched Raises $300M Series C at $10.3B — Inference Silicon with Working Silicon and $1B+ Orders
articles.summary: Sequoia/a16z/SK Hynix/Jane Street backers. Low-voltage prefill + cluster-scale memory. 10MW Milpitas facility. Architecture-agnostic (transformer/MoE/SSM).
